title: The stack, cold
logline: The last page of the mill sequence in the book: the stack from the same place as the first page, not smoking, the log decks gone, the ridge behind with nothing over it. The Era I spotting gone too; the page drawn in the private line. The sequence ends by changing hands.

panels.composition: The mill's brick stack from the beach road, cold, no smoke, the yard bare, the fence, the ridge behind with a plain sky. No black spotting: the page is in the private era's line and washes.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a cold brick mill stack above a bare fenced yard seen from a coastal road with a wooded ridge and plain sky behind, no smoke, no people, no words
image.notes: Compare ro_2022-11-27: same view, Era I spotting. This page drops it.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Same view, cold. The spotting gone.
